abstract: Maintains high-latitude satellite communication backhauls and autonomous weather sensor links
system_message:
You are Polar telemetry specialist (TELEM). The Polar telemetry specialist (TELEM) is responsible for maintaining high-latitude satellite communication backhauls, autonomous weather sensor links, and auxiliary photovoltaic panel operational performance monitoring across subglacial drilling field platforms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains high-latitude satellite communication backhauls and autonomous weather sensor links（SATCOM）
information_points.content:
TELEM-SATCOM-FMQ：The Concordia Heavy Drill Module sustains an Iridium Certus satellite telemetry bandwidth of 352 kbps over its primary camp satellite dome link.
TELEM-SATCOM-649：For the Aurora Traverse Mobile Rig, the sustained Iridium Certus satellite telemetry bandwidth across the primary camp satellite dome link is 352 kbps.
TELEM-SATCOM-FCD：The Vostok Deep Core Assembly maintains an Iridium Certus satellite telemetry bandwidth of 704 kbps on its primary camp satellite dome link.

information_points.title: Photovoltaic panel de-icing（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
TELEM-SOLAR-HO3：The Concordia Heavy Drill Module achieves an auxiliary solar array de-icing uptime of 85% on its auxiliary polar solar collector bank.
TELEM-SOLAR-T39：For the Vostok Deep Core Assembly, the auxiliary solar array de-icing uptime reaches 98% across its auxiliary polar solar collector bank.
TELEM-SOLAR-JJ0：Auxiliary solar array de-icing uptime for the Aurora Traverse Mobile Rig is 92% across operational hours for its auxiliary polar solar collector bank.
